scope: Holy Trinity Cathedral in Karachi around 2002, with the crenellated shortened clock tower, barrel-roofed sandstone nave, side arcades and chancel.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The national heritage inventory records the stone masonry church and bell tower.
The organization records the 1904 removal of the upper two tower levels.
The government gazetteer gives a 115-foot nave and documents the original taller tower and its reduction.
The edited historical account records that the new barrel-vaulted roof was installed in the 1970s.
